name: Difficulty
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: A slider for everything that makes Ratchet & Clank hard or easy: how many enemies there are, the damage Ratchet takes and deals, how fast the enemies and Ratchet move, weapon and ammo prices, ammo per shot and max ammo, bolt drops, max health and health pickups. Presets fill them: Easy, Retail, Hard, Brutal, and Chaos, which rolls new values for each level from a seed (and, if you like, a random event every few minutes). Every slider at 1.0 plays as the original game.

settings.name: Preset
settings.description: The values every slider left at 1.0 takes. A slider you move off 1.0 wins over the preset (Custom from that slider on). Chaos rolls new values for each level from the seed. Custom: only the sliders.

settings.name: Enemy count
settings.description: Above 1: copies of the enemies beside them, as room in the level allows (bosses, waves, turrets and scripted enemies never). Below 1: that share of the free-roaming enemies left out. Counts from the next level loaded.

settings.name: Damage to Ratchet
settings.description: Cells of health a hit takes, on average: 2 is two cells a hit, 0.5 a cell every other hit.

settings.name: Damage to enemies
settings.description: The damage of every hit on an enemy or a boss: your weapons, the wrench, explosions.

settings.name: Enemy speed
settings.description: How fast enemies and turrets move, turn, animate and fire (what their own clocks run on).

settings.name: Weapon prices
settings.description: What the Gadgetron vendor and the NPCs ask for weapons and gadgets.

settings.name: Ammo prices
settings.description: The vendor's price for each round of ammo.

settings.name: Ammo per shot
settings.description: Rounds each shot uses, on average.

settings.name: Max ammo
settings.description: How much ammo each weapon holds.

settings.name: Bolt drops
settings.description: Bolts from enemies and crates. 0: none.

settings.name: Max health
settings.description: Cells of health: the HUD shows 1 to 5 or 8, so the nearest of those at or below (4 cells at 2.0 make 8; with Ultra Nanotech 8 stays the most).

settings.name: Health pickups
settings.description: Cells each nanotech pickup gives, on average. 0: none.

settings.name: Seed
settings.description: For Chaos: the 8-character code from the log plays the same rolls again; any other word too. Blank: a new seed each start, shown in the log.

settings.name: Chaos events
settings.description: Every few minutes, a random event for 45 seconds: Turbo Ratchet, slow motion, frenzy, glass cannon, bolt rain, ammo famine, ... (with any preset).

settings.name: Minutes between events
settings.description: Of play, with Chaos events on.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: more lines in the game's log (each level's values, max health changes).
